invariants.statement: A mapped enemy template/runtime id resolves to its variant slug before any texture lookup; unmapped ids keep legacy texture/placeholder resolution.
Under ENTITY_ART_MODE=static exactly ANIMATED_ENEMY_KEYS emit kind:animated; no other entity drifts animated.
Emitted sourceSize equals the idle-clip union alpha bbox so origin (0.5,1) lands on the character feet line.
Loaders enumerate the MonsterArt registry only; reskinned template ids skip their old PNG; reserved unregistered variants are never loaded.
An animated enemy death clip completes before sprite destruction; completion callbacks are key-filtered and identity-checked; re-entry anim registration is idempotent.
Hand-written registry entries equal generated manifest metadata (clip frames, sheet/atlas names, extent, sourceSize, avatar dims).
Authored attack clips play once and return to standby; entities without attack clips keep the shared lunge and are unaffected.
